title: Sr. iOS Engineer
description:
We're building the next generation of travel and expense (T&E) technology using AI and large language models. Our mobile platform blends cutting-edge AI with strong product and UX so travelers get an intelligent companion, not just another booking app. The app should understand needs, anticipate requests, and deliver personalized help through conversational UI and rich, immersive interactions.  
  
You'll work at the intersection of AI and mobile, helping define how travelers interact with this kind of product on iOS.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and ship innovative UX patterns for **conversational interfaces and AI-driven experiences** on iOS
* Architect and build **Swift-first**, production grade features using **async/await**, structured concurrency and modern iOS APIs
* Lead implementation of **context-aware experiences** using behavior, preferences, and app state with an emphasis on performance and privacy
* Use **metrics, experimentation, and validation** (analytics, A/B tests, logging) to iterate on features and improve quality over time
* Turn **complex AI/ML capabilities** into simple, intuitive **mobile interactions**
* Use AI tools (e.g., **Claude Code** / **LLM‑based coding assistants**) to accelerate development while maintaining a high‑quality, well‑tested codebase
* **Collaborate** across product, design, and backend in a fast-moving environment

**What We're Looking For:**

* **5+ years** of professional development experience with strong **Swift** skills, building high quality iOS apps
* Deep understanding of **Swift** and the iOS SDK, including:
* + **Swift concurrency (async/await, Task, actors)**, structured concurrency, and modern GCD usage
  + **SwiftUI** for building production UIs; familiarity with UIKit and interoperability is a plus
  + Experience with **Combine** or other reactive patterns, and when to prefer them vs. async/await
* Strong grasp of **iOS architecture** (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization) suitable for AI‑powered, stateful, and real‑time features
* Solid understanding of **JSON**, **REST**, WebSockets, streaming APIs and robust networking layers (error handling, retries, offline support)
* Experience with **offline storage**, background processing, threading and **push notifications**
* Curiosity about **new** **interaction** **models** (chat, agents, multimodal UI, etc.)
* Experience using **AI development tools** (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.) as part of your workflow, with good judgment about code quality and security
* Familiarity with **LLM‑driven features** (prompt design, integrating LLM APIs, handling latency, fallbacks, guardrails) and/or **conversational UX**
* Track record building **consumer‑facing apps;** ideally you've shipped to the App Store and iterated from user feedback and metrics
* BS in Computer Science or related technical field

**Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.

* **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

title: Sr. Android Engineer
description:
Navan is looking for a Senior Android Engineer to design, build, and enhance our mobile applications in the business expense management space.

As a key contributor, you will work closely with our international team of engineers and domain experts to build new features and improve our product. We are looking for engineers who can deliver high-quality work, can lead complex projects and contribute to clear technical direction.

### **Required qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience developing high-quality Android applications.
* Strong understanding of the full app development lifecycle.
* Proficiency in Kotlin and building user interfaces with Jetpack Compose.
* Solid understanding of the Android SDK:
* + App components (Activities, Services, receivers, providers) and how they fit together.
  + How the Android applications you develop fit into the Android OS lifecycle: notifications, deep links, battery modes, network state, persisting data, and permissions.
  + Performance tuning and optimization.
  + Gradle builds and modules.
* Strong understanding of concurrency practices and experience working with coroutines;
* Must be capable of making architectural judgment calls based on real data and requirements.
* + Working knowledge of MVVM and standard multi-tier architecture.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and publishing to the Play Store.
* Solid foundation in data structures and algorithms, with a focus on delivering testable, scalable, and maintainable code.
* Experience using AI / LLM tools in day-to-day development, including how to keep quality, review standards, and security intact when you use them.
* Experience with modern Android frameworks such as Dagger/Hilt and OkHttp/Retrofit,
* Experience building automated test suites with Espresso/kakao and a clear view of what belongs in unit, integration, and UI tests.
* Familiarity with:
* + Accessibility best practices for mobile applications.
  + OAuth, mobile app authentication, and data safety.
  + Material Design principles, mobile UX practices, and patterns.

### **What you will do:**

* Design, build, and ship Android features in a large production app;
* Contribute to Android infrastructure so delivery stays fast and reliable.
* Review code, give feedback to other developers, and write technical documentation to improve coding practices and code quality.
* Lead development initiatives, whether by introducing new technologies or by raising the bar for existing code, practices, or architecture.
* Take part in decisions with peers and stakeholders on technology, design, and product direction.
* Triage product and application issues, and respond quickly to customer problems.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Mobile App Development
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Patient Care Solutions Mobile Center of Excellence (Mobile CoE) is focused on building secure, scalable and high-quality mobile solutions while establishing reusable capabilities, engineering patterns and development practices that can be adopted across multiple products.  
  
The Senior Software Engineer is a strong hands-on technical contributor responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of mobile application features and shared mobile capabilities. The role works closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, UX, Security, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver solutions aligned with Mobile CoE architecture and engineering standards.  
  
The individual should have strong mobile engineering fundamentals and demonstrate expertise in mobile architecture, performance, security, observability, automation, CI/CD, AWS cloud-integrated development and AI-assisted software engineering.

**Job Description**
===================

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test and deliver high-quality mobile application features, reusable components and shared capabilities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Tech Leads and UX teams to understand requirements, assess technical feasibility and translate requirements into implementable solutions.
* Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews and architecture decisions, bringing a strong mobile engineering perspective.
* Apply established Mobile CoE architecture patterns, coding standards and engineering practices, while contributing improvements based on implementation experience.
* Build reusable mobile components, libraries and common capabilities that can be adopted across applications where appropriate.
* Maintain high code quality through clean design, code reviews, unit testing, automated quality checks and secure coding practices.
* Understand the end-to-end application architecture, APIs, AWS services and integrations while developing deep expertise in assigned components.
* Analyze and improve mobile application **performance, reliability, security and user experience** using appropriate profiling, diagnostics and engineering practices.
* Implement appropriate mobile security practices including authentication, authorization, secure storage, session/token management and protection of sensitive data.
* Build appropriate **logging, telemetry, crash reporting and observability** into mobile applications to support troubleshooting and operational monitoring.
* Contribute to automated build, test, CI/CD and release processes and continuously improve engineering efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues, participate in root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective solutions.
* Adopt an **AI-first engineering mindset**, using AI-assisted tools throughout the SDLC for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, code understanding, technical documentation and developer productivity.
* Identify opportunities to use AI to **automate repetitive engineering activities, accelerate development and improve software quality**, while ensuring appropriate human review and validation.
* Apply responsible AI-assisted development practices, ensuring generated code and recommendations are reviewed for **correctness, security, maintainability and compliance**.
* Share technical knowledge, reusable solutions, AI-enabled engineering practices and implementation learnings across the Mobile CoE.

**Desired Technical Skills / Experience**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, preferably **7+ years**, with significant experience in mobile application development.
* Strong experience with one or more modern mobile technologies such as **Flutter, React Native, iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin**.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, state management, navigation, application lifecycle and API integration.
* Experience building **reusable mobile components, SDKs, libraries or shared capabilities** across applications.
* Strong knowledge of mobile application performance optimization including startup, responsiveness, memory/resource utilization and network performance.
* Good understanding of UX principles, accessibility and mobile design systems.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secure storage, encryption, session/token management and secure mobile development practices.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and **AWS-hosted backend services**.
* Experience with automated testing including unit, integration and mobile UI automation.
* Experience with **mobile build automation and CI/CD pipelines**.
* Experience with logging, telemetry, crash reporting, diagnostics and application performance monitoring.
* Working knowledge of **AWS and cloud-integrated mobile architectures**, with an understanding of reliability, performance, security and cost-conscious engineering.
* Experience with static code analysis, security scanning and vulnerability remediation.
* Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe software development practices.
* Strong practical experience using **AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering tools** for coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation and code review support.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions rather than accepting generated code by default, with appropriate attention to **security, quality, maintainability and accuracy**.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve **developer productivity, engineering automation and software quality**.
* Exposure to building or integrating **AI-enabled application capabilities** is an advantage.
* Experience developing healthcare, regulated or security-sensitive applications is preferred.

**Mobile CoE Mindset**

* Think beyond a single application and identify opportunities for **reuse and standardization across mobile products**.
* Prefer common patterns and shared capabilities over application-specific solutions where appropriate.
* Contribute implementation learnings back into **Mobile CoE standards, reference patterns and engineering practices**.
* Help improve developer productivity through **automation, AI-assisted engineering, tooling and common development practices**.
* Collaborate across product teams to encourage consistent approaches to **architecture, security, quality, performance and observability**.
* Experiment with emerging **mobile and AI engineering technologies**, evaluate their practical value and help bring useful practices into the CoE.
* Share reusable approaches and engineering learnings so that improvements made for one product can benefit other mobile teams.

**Preferred Professional Training and Certifications**

* Professional training or certifications related to **iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native or other relevant mobile technologies**.
* AWS cloud fundamentals or developer certification.
* Training or certification related to **AI-assisted software development, application security, DevOps, Agile or software architecture** is an advantage.

**Desired Professional Characteristics**

* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments.
* Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across Product, Architecture, UX, Security, QA and DevOps teams.
* Proactive in identifying technical problems and proposing practical solutions.
* Willingness to share knowledge and support other engineers through technical discussions and code reviews.
* **Curious and experimental mindset toward AI and emerging engineering technologies, balanced with sound engineering judgment.**
* Continuous learning mindset with interest in advancing mobile, AWS and AI-enabled software engineering practices.
* undefined

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus; and drive ownership, always with unyielding integrity.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Sustaining Software Engineer (Android)
description:
**Why Verifone**
----------------



For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.



Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it's developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.



Verifone is proudly an in\-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co\-located.


**What's exciting about the role**
----------------------------------



This role offers the opportunity to build Android applications that power real\-world payment solutions, from concept to production. You'll work on innovative payment devices, create demos and integrations, solve complex customer challenges, drive performance improvements, and collaborate across product and engineering teams while gaining valuable fintech and platform expertise.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Design, develop, and maintain on\-device and off\-device Android applications for Verifone payment
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts and demos that showcase Verifone product offerings, integrations, and workflows.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product, engineering, and support teams.
* Contribute to transformation initiatives, including performance optimization, debugging and testing tools, and release readiness.
* Debug, analyze, and resolve customer\-reported issues; provide support for production defects.
* Participate in test automation, CI/CD improvements, and technical documentation efforts.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------


* Strong experience developing Android applications
* Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin.
* Solid understanding of Android application architecture, lifecycle management, and performance optimization.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, backend integration, and asynchronous/event\-driven communication.
* Familiarity with software architecture concepts, including microservices and distributed systems.
* Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to containerized environments (Docker; Kubernetes/EKS is a plus).
* Experience debugging complex systems across device, OS, and network layers.
* Familiarity with or interest in using AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (preferred).
* 6\+ years of experience in Android or embedded/mobile software development.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams.
* Proven ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar systems and "look under the hood."


**Our commitment**
------------------



Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
